steps.name: W
steps.text: You're still pushing forward?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Without treatment, you're definitely getting infected.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Why would I believe a devil?

steps.name: W
steps.text: A devil, huh?

steps.name: W
steps.text: So many devils around me all the time, sometimes I forget we even have that word.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Gah, stop following us!

steps.name: W
steps.text: I've been keeping my distance.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: And stop acting nice! If you're gonna kill us, just do it already!

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: Ru-Rublev, you really shouldn't provoke her...

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Okay. We're going then.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Ignore her.

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: S-sorry!

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: I don't care if I get infected! We don't need a devil's help!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Uh huh...

steps.name: W
steps.text: There's an abandoned hospital around here. Chernobog District Hospital.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Wanna know where it is?

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: Rublev...?

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Don't listen to her. She's trying to trick us.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Let's ditch her... quick.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: See that alley over there? You take that corner and I think we can get there in less than a minute!

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: ——Run!

steps.name: W
steps.text: They're fast.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: H-How did she catch up to us so quick?! Agh!

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: Rublev... your leg! Th-the blood is turning black...

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Ugh, I could've outran her if I didn't have to save you!

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: Sorry...

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Whatever! Just be quiet.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Don't let her find us.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Head down that street, turn left, and you'll come to a ruined plaza.

steps.name: W
steps.text: On the west side, that big white building, that's the hospital.

steps.name: W
steps.text: The abandoned hospital.

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: ...I think... she knows we're here...

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Because you don't listen to me——fine.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Hey, devil.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Why did you tell us that?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Felt like it.

steps.name: W
steps.text: How do you two know each other?

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: I found him while I was out looking for food.

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: Rublev saved me...

steps.name: W
steps.text: And that's why you do what he says?

steps.name: W
steps.text: No skin off my back. Whatever you want. But now it's time for you to help out your savior here.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: What are you gonna make him do?

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: Rublev...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Nothing. I told you, there's a hospital right over there.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I mean, Reunion isn't dumb, so they wouldn't waste perfectly good medical supplies... So if you wanna save your little pal Rublev, you're gonna have to steal.

steps.name: W
steps.text: It's a bunch of Infected thugs over there. Thugs who murdered your family and friends.

steps.name: W
steps.text: And that's the only place they'll have the drugs that can stop the onset of Oripathy.

steps.name: W
steps.text: So go steal, rob, loot, it's all good.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Just don't expect anybody to help you.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: No! Don't listen to her!

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: B-But...

steps.name: W
steps.text: No?

steps.name: W
steps.text: He knows your name, Rublev. Do you know his?

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: What does that have to do with anything?!

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Don't go! You can't do it! There's too many——

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: I... I want to try...

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: Rublev isn't the only one who got hurt in the Catastrophe...

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: There's so much pain... I...

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Why aren't you listening to me?!

steps.name: W
steps.text: He doesn't have to listen to you.

steps.name: W
steps.text: It's good that you wanna save those people.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Just keep that hospital in mind. They keep the supplies down in an underground storeroom.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You could get in through the vents in the parking garage, or through the sewers, as long as there's not too much toxic waste down there.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You could die there though.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: C'mon, your legs are shaking! You can't do it! We were dumb to even listen to a devil in the first place!

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Let's get out of here!

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: Eeep——

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Wh-What was that?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Some things went down in Lungmen... wiped some stuff out here too.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Why wouldn't folks have their eye on a perfectly good battlefield hospital here in Chernobog?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Why do you think... a devil like me would know that hospital so well?

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Because you——Umm, ah——

steps.name: W
steps.text: That must hurt like a bastard. I'm starting to think he's probably beyond help at this point.

steps.name: W
steps.text: If you don't act soon..

steps.name: W
steps.text: You might just die right here.

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: Ah...

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: You, ugh, what are you doing? Stay away from me!

steps.name: W
steps.text: To go?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Or not to go?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Oh... but what if it's already too late, even if you did go? There's a riot going on, it might be too hard to sneak in and grab the goods——

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: I-I'm going.

steps.name: W
steps.text: ——Yeah... you're dead.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Why are you still listening to her? I'm the one who saved you!

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: But I... want to try...

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: There's no way you can do it! We'll go to a drugstore, we'll find some food, that'll be enough!!

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: I'm sorry!

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Hey... wait!

steps.name: W
steps.text: If you knew his name, maybe you could call out and stop him? Kinda sad.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: You... you tricked him! You devil!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Tricked?

steps.name: W
steps.text: I haven't told a single lie.

steps.name: W
steps.text: But hey, whether or not you believe me, that's your call.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Whether or not you believe him, that's your call too.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: ...I, I'm gonna go find him, nnggh...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: H-He can't do anything without me...

steps.name: W
steps.text: You're scared he's gonna run away.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You're thinking... why did he leave you alone with me? With a devil?

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Am not!

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Suka! A monster like you——

steps.name: W
steps.text: Shut up.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Wait here for him. Don't move.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Or I'll kill you.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Nnng——

steps.name: W
steps.text: Who do you think I am?

steps.name: W
steps.text: I'm a killer.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I'm the killer who destroyed this city, hurt your parents and friends.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Ah... haha. That's right.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I forgot you had that blade. Look, it's got a Sarkaz charm on the hilt, and it's still bloody.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Whose blood do you think it is?

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: *Whimper*... I, I don't know... you made him...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Go ahead and cry. Kids can cry.

steps.name: W
steps.text: It's all up to you... whether you live or die.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: He can't do it...

steps.name: W
steps.text: You sure?

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: If I hadn't dug him out of those ruins, he'd already be dead...

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: He needs me.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Nope... nobody needs anyone.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Nobody does.

steps.name: W
steps.text: This ruined city got quiet again.

steps.name: W
steps.text: There's a lot less resistance, after that slaughter. That's a good thing. Less effort. Less death.

steps.name: W
steps.text: But it's quiet over at the hospital too. Nothing moving over there, as far as I can tell.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: He... he didn't...

steps.name: W
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Maybe... he didn't actually go...

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: It's been... Nng... so long...

steps.name: W
steps.text: He ran away.

steps.name: W
steps.text: But you saved him. Wouldn't he want to save you too?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Or maybe you're strong enough to save him, but he couldn't save you?

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: He... He can't do anything right!

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Like when we went looking for food! He couldn't even tell there was someone else in the store!

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: It's all his fault my leg got——!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Where are you going?

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: I... I'm going home alone...

steps.name: W
steps.text: I already told you, you leave and you die.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: But he already ran off!

steps.name: W
steps.text: Hah.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I can see it in your eyes. You hate him.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: N-No I don't!

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: But if... if he did go... it's been so long... he must be...

steps.name: W
steps.text: ——Shut up.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You won't know anything until he comes back.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You can sit here thinking he's coming back, or that he's not.

steps.name: W
steps.text: But if you're thinking that he's not, if you're doubting him, hating him, that's on you.

steps.name: W
steps.text: But you went right to thinking he blew it and ran off. Why?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Because you saved him? Because you're the strong one?

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: ...*whimper*.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Waaahhh——

steps.name: W
steps.text: You're still strong enough to cry.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Settle down. Give it a minute and you'll be in too much pain to cry.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You're young, you're not Sarkaz. So if can't take it anymore, you can tell me.

steps.name: W
steps.text: I'll end it for you.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Wah... aahhh... waahh...

steps.name: W
steps.text: You're losing consciousness.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Ah well... guess he won't make it in time.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: No... I can still...

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: I'll wait... for him...

steps.name: W
steps.text: You've got faith in him again. That's because you're scared to die.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Kids are a good judge of character. You won't get this kind of stuff out of me.

steps.name: W
steps.text: But he's definitely taking way too long.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Got maybe ten minutes.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Don't worry. If it comes down to it, I'm not gonna let a kid die in pain.

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...can't even whimper anymore, huh?

steps.name: W
steps.text: What are you thinking?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Do you hate me? Or him?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Or maybe you hate yourself for sticking your nose where it didn't belong, saving that kid, and getting yourself hurt?

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: ...I don't...

steps.name: W
steps.text: You sure?

steps.name: W
steps.text: So you can still talk. Guess I misjudged you.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Look, Rublev.

steps.name: W
steps.text: What do you think it is that decides what a person's gonna do?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Is it a nature or nurture thing? Where they're born, how they're born? What kind of baggage they're weighed down with?

steps.name: W
steps.text: Nah, none of that matters.

steps.name: W
steps.text: It's the whole, complete, sum total of the influences on his life, all those changing thoughts and beliefs.

steps.name: W
steps.text: And just how strong he believes in those beliefs.

steps.name: W
steps.text: You saved that kid, but you didn't really trust him completely. You looked down on him, because you saw yourself as his messiah.

steps.name: W
steps.text: But him? He's easy. You saved him, he wants to save you.

steps.name: W
steps.text: When it comes to this stuff, he's stronger than you are.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Keep the blade. It's a Sarkaz blade, so I'm allowed to stand in for its owner and give it to you.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Wave it around, learn to swing it, sell it for cash. Whatever. It's yours.

steps.name: W
steps.text: That's the deal.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: What... are you talking about...?

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: R-Rublev! Are you okay?!

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: Look!

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: I did it! I stole an entire box of medical supplies! Painkillers! Bandages!

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: Rublev...

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Keep it... down. I'm not dead yet...

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: O-Okay. Let me bandage your wound...!

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: How do you use the bandage...? Is- is this the Oripathy medicine? I-I'll open it...

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Aren't... your parents doctors?

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: Oh... they never taught me anything. But I'll try...

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: ...You got hurt?

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: I'm fine. Just a scratch... Somebody hit me with a piece of metal...

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Idiot...!

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: ...Hehe...

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Where's... the Sarkaz?

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: Oh... I didn't see her when I came back... Did she stay with you?

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: Rublev?

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: ...Say, um... What's... your name?

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: Oh? Err... Andrey.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Your whole name...?

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: Andrey Fyodorovich Ostrovsky... heh.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: What are you laughing at?

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: You finally asked, Rublev.

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: ...Sorry.

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: N-No, you don't have to apologize...

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: All right. How do you feel?

steps.name: Unyielding Child
steps.text: Better...?

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: Great!

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: Let's go back home. I'll help you up.

steps.name: Waifish Child
steps.text: The grown-ups will be very happy about this box!
I smiled, watching those kids.
If they were going to survive, they had to kill that seed of doubt.
You only suffer if you survive.
Like a moth to a flame, a worm in a hole.
You have to chase something, even at a cost.

steps.name: W
steps.text: Isn't that right...

steps.name: W
steps.text: ...Talulah?
